# SPS Mahal

> A centrally air-conditioned hall for 400 seated, a 100-seat dining hall, 3 lifts and a Vinayagar temple on the premises — on OMR at Kelambakkam.

Website: https://spsmahal.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98400 74697

## Contact
- SPS Mahal · No. 1/85, Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR), opp. Indian Oil Petrol Bunk, above Sathya Showroom, Kelambakkam, Chennai 603103 · +91 98400 74697 · spsmahalkelambakkam@gmail.com

## Key facts
- 400 seated in the main hall
- 100 seated in the dining hall
- 3 lifts
- 40 cars valet-parked, plus 80 bikes

## Facilities
- Centralised A/C main hall
- SPS Mini Hall (A/C)
- Dining hall for 100
- Bride & groom rooms
- 4 A/C guest rooms
- 3 lifts
- Vinayagar temple on premises
- Big LED screen
- Modern kitchen, vessels for 600
- 200 KVA generator
- CCTV
- Pooja items & unjal
- Valet parking
- 24 hrs hot water

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can SPS Mahal hold?
SPS Mahal's main hall seats 400 (floating capacity 600), with a dining hall for 100. The SPS Mini Hall seats about 150.

### Where is SPS Mahal?
No. 1/85, Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR), opp. Indian Oil Petrol Bunk, above Sathya Showroom, Kelambakkam, Chennai 603103.

### What facilities does SPS Mahal have?
Centralised A/C main hall, SPS Mini Hall (A/C), Dining hall for 100, Bride & groom rooms, 4 A/C guest rooms, 3 lifts, Vinayagar temple on premises, Big LED screen, Modern kitchen, vessels for 600, 200 KVA generator, CCTV, Pooja items & unjal, Valet parking, 24 hrs hot water.

### What are the hall timings?
Full day is 2 p.m. to 2 p.m.; half day is 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. or 2 p.m. to 10 p.m. Brahmin marriages: 2½ days.

### Is non-vegetarian food allowed?
No. Only vegetarian food is permitted, and liquor is strictly prohibited.

### How do I check if SPS Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98400 74697.
